method: One point per model, at the effort setting LiveBench ran it at (usually its highest).

datasets.name: LiveBench Overall
datasets.note: Mean score across all 7 suites. Cost per task is LiveBench's measured spend for every suite divided by the number of tasks.

datasets.name: LiveBench Long Agentic
datasets.note: Long-running work — applications extended over several turns of changing requirements, operations on an existing codebase over simulated months or weeks, and extended coding and optimisation tasks. Deterministic grading. Cost per task is LiveBench's measured spend for the suite divided by its number of tasks.

datasets.name: LiveBench Reasoning
datasets.note: Short logic, spatial and theory-of-mind questions, each with a single correct answer, graded against ground truth. Each question costs far less than an agentic task. Cost per task is LiveBench's measured spend for the suite divided by its number of tasks.

datasets.name: LiveBench Coding
datasets.note: Bug-fix tasks taken from real merged pull requests on a frozen codebase. Deterministic grading; a fix that breaks existing behaviour scores 0. Cost per task is LiveBench's measured spend for the suite divided by its number of tasks.

datasets.name: LiveBench Browser
datasets.note: Multi-step tasks in working web applications, completed through a real browser. Scored as the share of tasks passed. A model that cannot accept screenshots cannot do these tasks and scores 0. Cost per task is LiveBench's measured spend for the suite divided by its number of tasks.

datasets.name: LiveBench Data Analysis
datasets.note: Short data-analysis questions on small tables — finding runs of consecutive growth, mapping the columns of one table onto another, and converting a table between formats — each with a single correct answer, graded against ground truth. Each question costs far less than an agentic task. Cost per task is LiveBench's measured spend for the suite divided by its number of tasks.

datasets.name: LiveBench Research
datasets.note: Open-ended research briefs producing a written report. Graded against a rubric. Cost per task is LiveBench's measured spend for the suite divided by its number of tasks.

datasets.name: LiveBench Design
datasets.note: Layout and design tasks across presentations, PDFs and documents. Graded on visual and structural checks of the produced file. Cost per task is LiveBench's measured spend for the suite divided by its number of tasks.
